question: Which interface[] term should name Yggdrasil's cleartext TCP, TLS, QUIC, WS, WSS and SOCKS5 peering URIs? The closed vocabulary has no term for these node-to-node protocols, so the record keeps the nearest term `unknown` and the true names in interface_detail.
why: The public-peers repository lists tcp://, tls://, quic://, ws://, wss:// and SOCKS5 variants, none of which is an interface[] vocabulary term.
